name: Second Stage
summary: Expendable upper stage powered by a single Merlin 1D Vacuum (MVac) engine.
function: Ignites after stage separation (SES-1) to insert the payload into its target orbit, capable of multiple restarts for GTO, SSO, and direct-insertion missions.
materials: Shortened aluminum-lithium (Al-Li) monocoque tank sharing the same 3.7 m tooling as Stage 1, with an aft composite skirt and radiatively cooled MVac nozzle.

history: Stretched in the v1.1 and Full Thrust upgrades to accommodate densified subcooled propellants, giving Falcon 9 the delta-v margin to reserve Stage 1 propellant for recovery.
